import os
base='/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790689779/attempts/75b9ca6211d4403aafd75899a9af5d34/system/state/workspace/programs'; os.makedirs(base,exist_ok=True)
grid=[[7]*13 for _ in range(14)]
for r,c,v in [(9,5,6),(10,6,6),(9,8,3),(10,7,3),(11,6,0),(12,5,0),(11,7,8),(12,8,8)]: grid[r][c]=v
def transform(grid):
 h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0]); out=[row[:] for row in grid]
 from collections import defaultdict
 pts=defaultdict(list)
 for r in range(h):
  for c in range(w):
   if grid[r][c]!=7: pts[grid[r][c]].append((r,c))
 for color,xy in pts.items():
  if len(xy)<2: continue
  # take slope from any same-color pair with diagonal adjacency; extend line at the end
  for a in xy:
   for b in xy:
    dr=b[0]-a[0]; dc=b[1]-a[1]
    if abs(dr)==abs(dc)==1:
     # b is end if no next same color in that direction
     nr,nc=b[0]+dr,b[1]+dc
     if (nr,nc) not in xy:
      while 0<=nr<h and 0<=nc<w and out[nr][nc] in (7,color):
       out[nr][nc]=color; nr+=dr; nc+=dc
     break
   else: continue
   break
 return out
out=transform(grid)
print(out)
# demo reproduce concept function extends line for color1 from adjacency
demo=[[4]*27 for _ in range(13)]
for r,c,v in [(1,7,2),(2,5,2),(2,6,2),(3,5,3),(3,6,1),(4,7,1)]:demo[r][c]=v
print(transform(demo)[5:])
